peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 36.6% below its local comparables; 1 of 130 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $1,200,000 ($1,018 psf, 1,130–1,237 sq ft; 9 resales, May 2024–Apr 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,605 psf (range $1,299–2,612); 36.6% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $692,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

missing.reason: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured

lines.statement: Not available: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Mountbatten MRT about 580 m, Aljunied MRT about 740 m; closer than 231 of 662 similar developments (the same as 4). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 4 within 2 km; nearest Geylang Methodist School (Primary) about 940 m; more than 126 of 662 similar developments (the same as 165). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 11 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 220 m), more than 513 of 662 similar developments (the same as 79); nearest hawker centre Kallang Estate Fresh Market And Food Centre about 660 m; nearest park Kallang Riverside Park about 920 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Kallang Estate Fresh Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 5 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Zyanya, 2 new sales, about 600 m; Arina East Residences, 85 new sales, about 1,340 m; Grand Dunman, 72 new sales, about 1,350 m; Aurea, 39 new sales, about 1,700 m; The Continuum, 208 new sales, about 1,780 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 225 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 406 new sales and 553 resales (959 purchases); new sales were 42.3% of these purchases. Subsales (53) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Kallang Close GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,250 m; Tanjong Rhu Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,490 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 553 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 137 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 553 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 686 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−19.4%). Planning-area private resales −17.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
